verses.1: And you made the altar of wood. It was five cubits in length and five cubits in width. The altar was quite large in size. And its height was three cubits.
verses.2: And you made horns on all four of its sides. From these horns, you would get horns. And you watched him as he was being punished.
verses.3: And you shall make his intestines for his food, and his intestines for his drink, and his intestines for his clothing. For all of these things, you shall make a separate container.
verses.4: And you made for it a net of netting made of fine threads. You also made four rows of such netting on its sides.
verses.5: And it was placed under the crossbeam of the altar, at a low level. It remained there until about half of the altar’s height.
verses.6: And you made the altar of the sacrifice out of wooden beams. You also polished them until they were smooth.
verses.7: And he brought his instruments into the tent. The instruments were placed on both sides of the altar, while he carried it along.
verses.8: He will do it when he sees you on the mountain. That’s what he will do.
verses.9: And you built the courtyard of the palace with stone walls. The length of the courtyard was six cubits, and its width was one hundred cubits.
verses.10: And their hands were each forty in number, and their wrists also were forty in number. The bracelets they wore were made of gold.
verses.11: And in the temple of Zaphon, there were rows of columns, each one being a hundred cubits in length. Their capitals were also made of gold, with twenty columns per row.
verses.12: And the width of the courtyard towards the sea was fifty amahs. Its length was also twelve amahs, and its breadth was also twelve amahs.
verses.13: And the boundary of the garden extended from east to west for fifty amahs.
verses.14: And fifteen amotes were attached to their elbows; each amote had three arms.
verses.15: And on the second panel, there were fifteen columns. Each column had three branches, and each branch had three stems.
verses.16: And outside the gate of the storehouse, there were forty cubits of storage space for goods. There were also two looms and six other tools used for weaving. Their handles each measured four cubits in length.
verses.17: All the decorations around the courtyard are made of gold and silver. Their branches are also made of gold and silver.
verses.18: The length of the courtyard was one hundred cubits, and its width was fifty cubits. It was five meters in height, with six doors, and their handles were also attached to the walls.
verses.19: To all things in the house, in all its utensils and tools, and to all the devices of the courtyard.
verses.20: And you shall command the children of Israel to bring you pure wine for lighting a lamp, so that the light may shine forever.
verses.21: In the tent of meeting, outside the veil that covers it, Aaron and his sons shall serve there from evening until morning, before the LORD, according to forever, for all generations of the Israelites.
